description: This Java source file defines the AddFileActivity class for an Android application. It provides UI and logic to create files with specified names and sizes, support for various storage options (internal, external, no-backup), and handles intent extras for creating files directly. The activity manages user input validation, file creation with random data, and communicates success or error results back to calling components.

classes.name: AddFileActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that facilitates creating files with specified attributes and storage options.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, setting the layout and configuring spinners.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Checks for intent extras to pre-create a file and finishes the activity if parameters are valid.

methods.name: onCreateFileButtonClick
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new file upon user action, validating input before proceeding.

methods.name: initFileSizeSpinner
methods.description: Sets up the spinner for selecting file size multiples.

methods.name: initFileStorageSpinner
methods.description: Sets up the spinner for selecting the storage location.

methods.name: createFileWithRandomDataAndFinishActivity
methods.description: Creates a file with random content based on user parameters and reports success or failure.

methods.name: isFileExists
methods.description: Checks if a file with the given name already exists in internal storage.

methods.name: isSizeValid
methods.description: Validates whether the provided file size string is a non-negative number.

methods.name: isFileStorageParamValid
methods.description: Validates whether the storage parameter corresponds to a valid enum value.

methods.name: getInternalFile
methods.description: Returns a File object in the app's internal storage directory.
